author: Polygon Donut
description:
For some reason there's a series of Hot Wheels where they just MORPH famous characters into the shape of a car? And they always end up looking incredibly strange and uncanny... So today I'll fully dive in to these peculiar "Character Cars", because I find them really interesting!!!

Check out hot wheels wiki to learn more about them! Their efforts help so much with my research 🤓 https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Character_Cars

🎨 Special thanks to these artists!
ellielotus for character drawings https://www.instagram.com/ellielotus/
Pensilajaib09 for character emotes https://vgen.co/Pensilajaib09

📖Video Diary
This video is sort of a callback to my first hot wheels video ever!!! It has a similar thumbnail and I mention a few of the character cars in that one. And I really love how all the footage looks with the new parking garage dioramas I got! Hot wheels are so cool, I hope I get more ideas to keep talking about these lol.

Also, this is the fastest I've made a youtube video in year
title: Cursed Hot Wheels Collabs
